exposure: Utilization of immediate postpartum bilateral tubal ligation (BTL)
Utilization of immediate postpartum intrauterine devices (IUDs)
Utilization of immediate postpartum contraceptive implants
Utilization of immediate postpartum long-acting reversible contraception (LARC)
outcome: Utilization rates of specific postpartum contraceptive methods (BTL, IUDs, implants, Depo-Provera)
cohort: The study included 35,281 patients who delivered at a single academic hospital center between 2012 and 2020, excluding those with deliveries less than 23 weeks gestation or who underwent a cesarean or postpartum hysterectomy for obstetric indications.
finding: The study observed a significant increase in the utilization of immediate postpartum LARC over the 10-year study period, which corresponded to a significant increase in both interpregnancy interval (IPI) and interdelivery interval (IDI).
